newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Liberty, Korea's LG eye telecom venture.
newsitem.headline: Liberty, Korea's LG eye telecom venture.

text.p: Liberty Telecoms Holdings Inc said on Monday its board has decided to enter into an agreement with two units of South Korea's LG Group to provide a new telecom service in the Philippines.

In a notice to the Philippine Stock Exchange, Liberty said it will pursue a joint venture pact with LG Information & Communication Ltd and LG Telecom Ltd to introduce and provide personal communications service.
Personal communications is a lucrative service in Europe and the United States that is similar to a cellular mobile phone but operates at a higher band and can accomodate a bigger subscriber base.
The service is yet to be introduced in the Philippines and so far 17 firms have applied with the National Telecommunications Commission for a license.
